subject: Prototype run: surge-slab vs pro-rata amendment
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@blueriver.ai>; procurement@blueriver.ai
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prototype run: initial addendum and optional extension terms

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our discussion, attaching the first draft of a short addendum that covers the requested run extension mechanics and a couple of pricing options. Quick recap:

- Baseline pilot: 3 weeks, 200k tokens preloaded (as signed).
- Extension options we can offer:
  * Short extension (7 calendar days) priced at a pro-rata token top-up at the standard pilot rate; OR
  * Surge-slab (time-limited burst capacity): a 10% surcharge on rate but with added guaranteed concurrency for peak windows.

If you prefer credits vs pro-rata billing we can convert the extension into a 25% credit top-up applied only to generation tokens during the extension period.

I've attached POC_Addendum_BlueRiver_v1.pdf with the legal-friendly language and a redline placeholder for the exact number of days. If you can confirm whether you want (A) 7 days pro-rata, (B) 7 days with 25% credit, or (C) surge-slab we can finalize and push to DocuSign.

Also: if SOC2 artifacts are required for procurement, let me know and I'll get Marissa to surface the snapshot report.

Next steps: pick option and confirm whether you need a dedicated throughput window during US work hours next week.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachment: POC_Addendum_BlueRiver_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Samir Desai <samir@blueriver.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@blueriver.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prototype run: initial addendum and optional extension terms

Connor —

Thanks for the clean summary and the addendum. A couple of items from our side:

- We definitely need an extension but 7 calendar days won't be sufficient — can you do 14 calendar days? We want to validate a steady-state prompt workload over two full business weeks.
- Pricing: since this is an extension to validate production scaling we were hoping for a modest discount on the extension bucket — 20% off the normal pilot rate for the extra days.
- Throughput: we need guaranteed sustained concurrency of ~6 concurrent streams for a 3-hour window each weekday (10:00–13:00 PT). Is that possible under surge-slab?
- Compliance: procurement asked for SOC2 Type II evidence and a short summary of data retention settings for the pilot environment.

If you can send a counter with specific language on the extension length/discount and an SLA bullet for the throughput window we can expedite approval.

Appreciate it,
Samir Desai
Head of ML Engineering — BlueRiver Analytics
samir@blueriver.ai

Marissa / Karthik —

Looping you in. Samir at BlueRiver is asking for:

- 14 calendar days extension (they originally signed 3 weeks)
- 20% discount applied to the extension token bucket
- Guaranteed sustained concurrency ~6 streams during US morning (10:00–13:00 PT) each weekday
- SOC2 Type II artifacts for procurement

Can we do 14 days? If not, what's our counter (10 business days? 10 calendar days?) Also need guidance on whether we can include the throughput window as part of the extension (no extra hardware commitment) vs requiring a short burst add-on or refundable deposit. Karthik — can you run the numbers on margin impact for 14 days at 20% vs 10 days at 15% and confirm what finance is comfortable approving without exec sign-off?

I want to keep this moving — Samir is ready to sign if we land on a clean, short amendment.

Thanks,
Connor

Subject: Re: Fwd: Prototype run: initial addendum and optional extension terms — recommended counter

Connor —

Thanks for the ping. Quick recommendation from GTM & Solutions:

- Counter: 10 business days (14 calendar days can be noisy because of weekends) as the extension period.
- Discount: 15% off the standard pilot rate applied only to tokens consumed during the extension window.
- Throughput: include a daily guaranteed concurrency window (Mon–Fri, 10:00–13:00 PT) capped at 6 concurrent streams and up to 120 concurrent requests/hour during that window. We'll provide burst protection beyond that subject to our surge policy. No additional hardware deposit required for that level — treat it as a temporary routing policy for their pilot.
- Compliance: we'll send SOC2 Type II snapshot and the retention summary (see attachment).

If BlueRiver insists on 20% or 14 calendar days, we can offer a middle ground: 14 calendar days at 10% discount OR 10 business days at 15% (our preferred).

I'll attach a short SLA summary for the throughput window for you to send. If you want I can draft the exact addendum language (two-line amendment) and attach an updated PDF for DocuSign.

Marissa Cole
